## Summary of PR/Issue
- PR #214 adds an opt-in deterministic `agent-self-merge` workflow after current-head Sepo self-approval.
- It is the clean replacement requested by #213, stacked on #186, after #208 was identified as mis-stacked.
- The intended behavior is to merge or enable auto-merge into the PR’s configured base while preserving opt-in gating, current-head self-approval, requested-change checks, check/mergeability handling, and `--match-head-commit`.
- Docs, orchestration routing, authorization checks, marker status comments, and focused tests were updated with the new route.

## Review
The core safety shape looks sound and the rubrics review passed. The remaining issues are minor but worth fixing because they affect state-model clarity and user-visible traceability.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Unproduced `waiting` self-merge state | WARNING | `SelfMergeConclusion` exposes `waiting` and docs/tests treat it as terminal, but `resolveSelfMerge` never returns it. This can drift from real runtime behavior. |
| Merged path skips self-merge status comment | WARNING | `.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-merge.ts` suppresses marker-upserted status comments when the result is `merged`, unlike blocked, failed, or auto-merge outcomes. |

## Progress
- Linked context was reviewed: #213, parent #170, and the #208 stacking discussion.
- Existing PR conversation had no prior inline review comments or review threads before synthesis.
- Posted inline comments for both concrete changed-line findings: `.agent/src/self-merge.ts:3` and `.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-merge.ts:200`.
- No inline replies were added, and no comments or threads were resolved or minimized.
- Rubrics review reported PASS with no rubric-specific findings.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Unproduced `waiting` self-merge state</summary>

**Cause:** [`SelfMergeConclusion`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/4550602425944e445c08f8c1b2dd2ed2278498af/.agent/src/self-merge.ts#L3) includes `waiting`, and formatting/docs/tests account for it, but `resolveSelfMerge` only returns `merged`, `auto_merge_enabled`, `blocked`, or `failed`.

**Candidate solutions:** Add the intended resolver path that emits `waiting` with focused coverage, or remove/document the reserved state consistently across code, docs, and tests.

**Comments:** Raised by one reviewer as a minor implementation clarity issue; no reviewer found this to be a merge-safety blocker.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Merged path skips self-merge status comment</summary>

**Cause:** [`status_post`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/4550602425944e445c08f8c1b2dd2ed2278498af/.agent/src/cli/resolve-self-merge.ts#L200) is set to `false` when `conclusion === "merged"`, so immediate success writes an artifact but no Sepo PR-thread status.

**Candidate solutions:** Prefer posting the compact marker-upserted status for `merged` too, with CLI/workflow coverage. If the comment-free success path is intentional, document and test that policy explicitly.

**Comments:** Reviewers differed slightly on framing: one treated this as an idempotent status gap, while another noted the merge event may be self-evident. Synthesis treats it as a minor traceability fix.
</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: The unresolved warnings are small, concrete branch changes and are safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

MINOR_ISSUES

- [ ] Make successful immediate self-merges post a marker-upserted status, or explicitly document and test the intentional skip.

Compared with #208, #214 does remove unrelated/mis-stacked scope like self-approval implementation, release prep, review synthesis, and extra workflow/prompt changes. But because #186 does not already contain self-merge, this PR still introduces the full deterministic merge route end-to-end.

1. Resolver + GitHub helpers + focused self-merge tests.
